request.spec:
Let me tuck away clients I no longer work with. They should drop off my list and my search.
I do not want to lose them. Note it when I do.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me tuck away clients I no longer work with. They should drop off my list and my search.
I do not want to lose them. Note it when I do.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. The change is complete.

## Summary

I implemented **archiving clients** as a full-stack, additive change, mirroring the existing project-archiving pattern:

- **Migration** `V17__clients_archived.sql` — adds an `archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` column, so existing clients stay visible.
- **`ClientRepository`** — `findAll()` now filters `WHERE archived = FALSE` (drops archived clients off the list and, by extension, the name search); added `findById(id)` and `archive(id)`.
- **`ClientsArchivePostLogic`** + **`ArchiveClient`** + **`rest/api/clients/archive.POST.yml`** — a new `POST /api/clients/archive` endpoint that flags the row archived (row is retained, nothing lost) and records the audit line `CLIENT_ARCHIVED id=<id>` via the injected `Audit` service.
- **`ClientsPage.tsx`** — an `Archive` button (`data-testid="client-archive-<id>"`) that calls the endpoint and removes the client from the visible list.

The Playwright spec confirms the client drops off the list, the row count matches, and the audit line is emitted.
